fluff.overview: Caesar's ongoing program to modernize the Legiones Marianes has extended to conventional infantry formations, with improved equipment and weapons gradually replacing older stockpiles across the Hegemony's auxiliary legions. A contubernium is the smallest tactical unit in the Marian system, equivalent to a single reinforced squad of ten soldiers. Foot contubernia serve as sentries, checkpoint garrisons, and building-clearing teams in urban operations where larger formations cannot maneuver effectively. Command personnel carry sidearms and rifles suited to personal defense rather than front-line engagement, reflecting their primary role as coordinators rather than riflemen.
